scheme_disclosure: scheme:'exact' on this surface is a per-lane binding, NOT stock EIP-3009: Algorand = AVM note-bound (tx_id+note submission); Base = EIP-3009 with a mandatory nonce==keccak256(payment_reference) weld; Solana = mandatory server-derived reference account. Off-the-shelf x402 clients cannot pay any lane without the AlgoVoi binding.

payment_binding.note_value: the RAW payment_reference token string from the 402 (UTF-8)
payment_binding.note_encoding: the SDK base64-encodes the tx note field itself; do NOT pre-encode

metering: POST-only. GET the same URL returns a strict-v2 402 probe over an example body for scanner discovery; the metered call is POST your real body.

authorization_weld.nonce: keccak256(payment_reference), optional; NOT required (lane accepts tokenless stock payments)

networks.note: scheme:exact = stock EIP-3009 signed authorization we settle; STOCK EVM x402 clients CAN pay this lane (EIP-712 domain name 'USD Coin' version '2', chainId 8453, to == payTo, value == price exact). An optional challenge_token binds the payment to the request/lane/TTL, not required.
scheme:exact = Solana reference-bound settlement; include the server-derived svm_reference_pubkey (from the 402) as a read-only account in your USDC transfer
scheme:exact = Stellar MEMO_TEXT-bound settlement; set the tx MEMO_TEXT to the server-derived weld (from the 402). Stock clients cannot pay this lane.
scheme:exact = Hedera TIP tx-memo-bound settlement of native USDC (HTS); set the tx memo to the server-derived bytes weld (from the 402). Stock clients cannot pay this lane.

networks.asset_note: Aramid-bridged USDC (ASA), not native Circle USDC
networks.note: scheme:exact = Voi AVM ASA note-bound settlement; set the tx note to the server-derived weld (from the 402). Stock clients cannot pay this lane.

networks.asset_note: bridged USDC.e (Stargate) on Tempo, not native Circle USDC
networks.note: scheme:exact = Tempo TIP-20 transferWithMemo settlement; call transferWithMemo with the bytes32 memo weld (from the 402). A plain ERC-20 transfer is rejected.

services.grade: pay-tier structural safety screen (SSRF/private-network/metadata-host/homograph/TLS); full compliance/sanctions screening is a tenant-grade service

receipts.payable_receipt: Ed25519 JWS, kind algovoi/payable-svc-receipt/1, binds settled_payment_ref -> request_hash -> response_hash

single_use: each (network, tx_id) buys exactly one call; identical re-POST replays the stored response; a different request on the same tx is a 409, never a leaked result
